title: Black Forest Labs published a FLUX 3 blog update
summary: On 2026-07-24, Black Forest Labs published a blog page identified by the FLUX 3 URL and linked a Tally form. This is a material public-development signal for FLUX 3, although the dated links alone do not establish the specific capability, release status, or purpose of the form.
research_notes: FLUX 3 entered Early Access as a unified multimodal model, while Video, Image, Action, and Dev access were staged separately.
